name: BACCARAT BANQUE
description: Baccarat Banque (also known as Baccarat à Deux Tableaux) is the most prestigious and intellectually challenging form of Baccarat. Played at massive kidney-shaped tables in Europe's most exclusive casinos, it features a single Banker who handles the shoe and plays against two separate hands—representing the left and right sides of the table—simultaneously. It is a game of immense bankrolls, complex drawing choices, and high-altitude gambling psychology.

content.text: Baccarat Banque (also known as Baccarat à Deux Tableaux) is the most prestigious and intellectually challenging form of Baccarat. Played at massive kidney-shaped tables in Europe's most exclusive casinos, it features a single Banker who handles the shoe and plays against two separate hands—representing the left and right sides of the table—simultaneously. It is a game of immense bankrolls, complex drawing choices, and high-altitude gambling psychology.

The oldest form of Baccarat, dating back to 19th-century France. While Chemin de Fer was for private salons, Baccarat Banque was the game of the great public casinos in Vichy, Dieppe, and Monte Carlo.
Variable. One Banker, sitting in the middle. Players sit at 'Tableau 1' (Left) and 'Tableau 2' (Right).
Three standard 52-card decks shuffled together (156 cards).
Oval baccarat table with two betting wings, a massive shoe, and a Banker's palette.
The Banker deals three hands: one for the players on the left, one for the players on the right, and one for themselves.

items.text: Banque Limitée: The Banker specifies a fixed amount they are willing to risk; once gone, the bank closes.
